purpose: Independent source-only coarse owner8 anatomy/garment/head envelopes for external diagnostics before any frozen-reference change.
coordinate_convention: Integer source pixel centres. Polygon boundary pixels are inclusive, matching Pillow ImageDraw.polygon; each list is a union of polygons. Rectangles represented as four inclusive corner vertices.

mask_semantics.skin_supports: Union of actual visible face/neck, arm and leg envelopes. These are candidate supports, not unconditional skin labels; preserve alpha/outline invariants and apply garment exclusions with precedence.
mask_semantics.garment_exclusions: Actual front garment/fur trim and, where present, calf wraps. Clothing is not inferred from its brown color alone.
mask_semantics.hair_envelopes: Coarse scalp/gather/fringe and visible back-fall candidate supports, excluding face/neck/collar regions; not a pixel-exact hair silhouette denominator.
mask_semantics.no_gate_waiver: No coverage threshold is changed and no fixed source box is shrunk. Completeness and contamination both require separate diagnostic review.
mask_semantics.facial_hair_envelopes: Dedicated actual adult beard/sideburn candidate supports; empty for every female/child owner. Never use this exception to bypass skin precedence for arbitrary head regions.

independence.geometry_basis: Original source anatomy reinspection; no tracing of selected mask contours or shrinking to metric targets.

limits: These are broad semantic envelopes, not pixel-by-pixel segmentation. Border uncertainty is recorded rather than silently converted into a PASS.
Fur/collar, beard/neck, hand/trim and calf-wrap boundaries require source-comparison diagnostics.
Hidden anatomy and obscured hair fall are not reconstructed.
Appearance briefs preserve source clothing and visible hair geometry; they do not alter the fixed identity/variant axes.
